name: Nacelle Vibration Level
description: Mechanical vibration in the nacelle drivetrain. Checks whether vibration amplitude stays within operational limits.

elements.name: Peak Vibration Amplitude
elements.description: Peak vibrational velocity in the nacelle. Uncertain due to wind gusts and rotor imbalance.

uncertainty.source: Field measurement campaign on similar turbines

elements.name: Vibration Shutdown Threshold
elements.description: ISO 10816-21 shutdown threshold for wind turbines

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(a_vib) = a_vib if a_vib <= a_max, else ∅
consistency_relations.upr_description: The ISO 10816-21 shutdown threshold guards the vibration amplitude uncertainty set; amplitudes above 4.5 mm/s trigger emergency stop.
